title: Correct final time
description: Essential Criteria: The answer for part (1) must be 12 seconds.

title: Correct final speed
description: Essential Criteria: The answer for part (2) must be 4 m/s.

title: Acceleration phase analysis
description: Important Criteria: Correctly applies kinematics to find the time and distance during the upward acceleration phase (a = 2 m/s²).

title: Deceleration phase analysis
description: Important Criteria: Correctly applies kinematics to find the time and distance during the upward deceleration phase (a = -1 m/s²).

title: Constant speed phase
description: Important Criteria: For part (2), correctly incorporates the constant speed phase and its duration into the total displacement equation.

title: Total displacement equation
description: Important Criteria: Sets up and solves the correct equation summing the displacements from all phases to equal the total height of 48 m.

title: Sign error in deceleration
description: Pitfall Criteria: Uses an incorrect sign for the deceleration (e.g., treats it as positive acceleration) when calculating displacement or time.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Maintains consistent units (meters, seconds, m/s) throughout the solution.
